# statusgen/36 row 10 — witness digest / Runner-cell grammar has ONE owner,
# statusgen/evaluation. Each line: path | pattern | reason. A hit outside the
# library must be listed here with the reason it is not a second witness
# parser; a listed entry that no longer matches fails the test.
statusgen/coverage_witness.go | git-tree-read | port adapter: implements evaluation.WitnessRepo by shelling git; supplies bytes and OIDs only, never judges
statusgen/coverage_witness.go | record-dir | port adapter: lists record files at a revision through the library's directory constant
statusgen/readset_adapter.go | git-tree-read | read-set port adapter: exports a witness commit's tree for the compile-input floor's go list and reads read-set files; supplies bytes only, never judges
statusgen/coverage_repo.go | git-tree-read | v1 coverage repo adapter: tree listing and entry lookup for the coverage evaluation, not witness content
statusgen/briefinfo.go | git-tree-read | flag name check-attribution matched the check-attr substring; no git read
statusgen/decisiongatehold.go | git-tree-read | decision-gate hold reads brief files at a revision; unrelated to witnesses
statusgen/idvalidate.go | git-tree-read | brief-id validation lists tree paths; unrelated to witnesses
statusgen/mergecheck.go | git-tree-read | merge check lists files in a merge; unrelated to witnesses
statusgen/registers.go | git-tree-read | register discovery reads tree paths; unrelated to witnesses
statusgen/verifyrows.go | git-tree-read | advisory text inside a lint message; no git read
statusgen/verifyrun.go | runner-at-split | splits a git author email at the at-sign for a local-part identity; not a Runner cell
statusgen/witnessdigest.go | record-field-key | witnessdigest verb output struct: prints library results as JSON, computes nothing itself
